subject: Keystone: demo timing during re:Invent + Thanksgiving blackout
messages:
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@keystonehealth.com>
To: olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Cc: sales_ops@keystonehealth.com
Date: 2026-11-05T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Keystone demo — timing constraints (re:Invent + Thanksgiving)

Hi Olga,

Thanks for the invite — we’re excited to see the keystone demo. Quick heads up on scheduling constraints: several of our execs and product leads will be at AWS re:Invent Nov 27–Dec 1, and our procurement/IT teams have a Thanksgiving-week blackout for approvals (Nov 24–26). That narrows the meaningful live-demo windows for our decision-makers.

Options we’re considering:
- Keep a short recorded walkthrough (30–40 min) the week of Nov 29 and do a live 30-min Q&A the following week (Dec 7–11).
- Move the full live demo to the week of Dec 7 so execs can attend in-person.
- If neither works, we can accept a recorded demo + written answers to a short RFI.

Ideally we’d like the recording delivered by Dec 3 so our team can review before the live Q&A. I attached a quick list of tech/PHI questions we want covered (Keystone-Requirements.docx).

Can you confirm what’s possible and whether you can provide an async recording?

Best,
Emily
Senior IT Program Manager
Keystone Health

Attachments: Keystone-Requirements.docx (docx)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@keystonehealth.com>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-05T13:15:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Keystone demo — timing constraints (re:Invent + Thanksgiving)

Hi Emily — thanks for the heads up and for the requirements doc. Totally understand the blackout windows. We can support all three options; here are tradeoffs and what I recommend: 

1) Asynchronous recording + 30-min live Q&A (recommended)
   - We can record a targeted 35-min run-through (focus: data residency, KMS, on-prem connector) and deliver by 2026-12-01 if you need more polish or by 2026-11-30 for earlier review.
   - Follow-up live Q&A: propose 2026-12-08 10:00–10:30 PT (or 2026-12-09 16:00–16:30 CET).

2) Full live demo week of Dec 7
   - Karthik is available to host the technical portion if you want an interactive session with our infra lead. I can also present at a high level.

3) Recorded + RFI answers
   - If you prefer written responses instead of a live session, we can provide a short RFI deck and written answers within 3 business days of the recording review.

I attached our latest demo deck for alignment (Redwood-Demo-Deck-v3.pptx).

Please let me know which option you prefer and whether the Dec 8 Q&A window works. If you confirm the Dec 8 slot we’ll lock it and start producing the recording.

Thanks —
Olga
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com
Attach: Redwood-Demo-Deck-v3.pptx (pptx)
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: 2026-11-05T13:22:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Keystone demo — timing constraints (re:Invent + Thanksgiving)

Folks — looping you in. Keystone is asking for either a recorded walkthrough + live Q&A (preferred) or a full live demo the week of Dec 7. Execs will be at re:Invent and procurement is dark the Thanksgiving week, so we need to be flexible.

Ask: can Karthik host the technical Q&A on Dec 8 if we do the recorded run-through? Also need someone to produce a 35-min recording by end of Nov/first of Dec. Marcus — can you coordinate a quick recording session (script + screen capture) and ensure we hit the KMS/on-prem/connectors sections Emily flagged? Would prefer an edited MP4 and a short notes doc.

If Marcus is swamped, propose we do a live dry-run with internal attendees and capture that for Keystone.

Thanks —
Olga

Subject: Re: Keystone demo — timing constraints (re:Invent + Thanksgiving)

Hi Olga — thanks for the quick options. We’d prefer option 1 (recording + live Q&A). Dec 8 10:00 PT works for the Q&A. A couple of requests: 

- Could you deliver the recording by 2026-12-01 at the latest? We’ll try to review before the Q&A but procurement needs the content early.
- Please include a 2–3 slide appendix that explicitly answers these PHI/software isolation questions from page 2 of our requirements doc (KMS scope, data retention defaults, audit log retention).
- We’ll need the deck and recording accessible to our procurement reviewers via a secure link (DocuSign is not needed today, just an internal Share link).

If you can confirm delivery date and host for the Q&A (Karthik or Olga) we’ll lock the calendar.

Appreciate it —
Emily
Senior IT Program Manager, Keystone Health
